experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1, 9.8 and 9.9 on the priced instance (flags 3, counter t by step CT) for one context from the seed: the work register test, the context lines and the descriptor table (packed, amendment G), 32 clusters with their representative batches, gate values, opened clusters (the high-part tests of amendments H and I, then five partner batches or the descriptor's two chunks, 8 units a partner lane), test (2) on R2 and L2, E lanes, the cached Y9 fill, T1, passing lanes with the shortcut, pre-check and preflight, the metered joint solver with (G7) and (G15) and the root predicate, and the units of proof.md Section 11 and the amendment. In the same run every walked member is recomputed straight-line, closed and dead clusters and left-out partners are tested bit by bit for (2) and the LW rule, gate values and descriptors are checked against scalar words, every cached Y9 against a fresh fill, every passing lane and solver call against a scalar rebuild and the ledger, every E lane's message is compressed, and every 8th trial plants a joint root that both traversals must return. The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, the c1 forcing t = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member. No BLAKE3 library.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits. This is exact: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, and the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5; none enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted and not recomputed by the organizer: members (walked), e_lanes (test-(2) passes), passes, solver_calls, leaves, roots, certified, units (charged machine units), solver_units (the solver ledger by nodes), opened and closed (clusters), skipped_pass (members of closed clusters or partners left out that pass (2) bit by bit), checks, mismatches (a solver call above its cap, a metered debit that differs from the ledger, a guard word, bank word or cache entry that differs counts as one), fills (batches whose packed Y9 was built, one per batch with an E lane) and halted. Expected per trial: 32 clusters, about 41% opened (proved bound 0.4064), about 100 walked members, 53 E lanes in 13 filled batches and 0.9 passes, about 0.28 solver calls per pass, almost always no root; skipped_pass, mismatches and halted 0. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer; the run is not evidence of attack cost.
